The '''Ord Groner system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] found in the [[Khuiumin sector/Legends|Khuiumin sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Grovner]]
